features.description: Cloudflare Access JWT verification middleware + CORS for SPA origins
features.notes: Phase 0 of portage-ui-foundation OpenSpec change. Verifies Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion against the team JWKS via jose createRemoteJWKSet (module-level cache TTL >= 10 min). Allows email == eovidiu@gmail.com only. Coexists with existing Bearer JWT path: if Cf-Access header present, verify it; else fall back to Bearer; else 401. Worker secrets CF_ACCESS_TEAM and CF_ACCESS_AUD required (Ovidiu sets up Zero Trust + Google IdP per design.md walkthrough — service-token bypass policy preserves Bearer for cron + iOS). CORS middleware allows https://app.portage.eovidiu.co.uk and http://localhost:5173. No-auth requests (other than /healthz, /auth/*/callback) return 401.

features.description: GET /api/me endpoint returning authenticated principal { email, kind }
features.notes: Phase 0 of portage-ui-foundation. Reads c.var.principal set by F-019 middleware. user kind returns { email, kind: 'user' }; service kind returns { kind: 'service' } with no email. SPA AuthGate calls this on mount and treats 401 as 'not signed in' (redirects to CF Access).

features.description: GET /api/playlists endpoint listing playlist_configs rows for the operator console
features.notes: Phase 4 of portage-ui-foundation. F-016b shipped (PR #14) so Phase 4 is no longer gated. Extends src/db/playlist_configs.ts with listAll(). Returns __liked__ row first, then extras by created_at. Authenticated only (F-019 enforces).

features.description: POST /api/playlists endpoint adding a Spotify playlist to the registry
features.notes: Phase 4 of portage-ui-foundation. Validates spotify_playlist_id against ^[A-Za-z0-9]{22}$ at the route layer; calls fetchSpotifyPlaylistName (F-016) to populate display_name. Idempotent on duplicate (returns 200 with existing row). Spotify 404 on the id maps to 404 spotify_playlist_not_found. Authenticated only.
